name: Barrier Gel Glass-Moisturizer
description: A lightweight gel cream enriched with 5 ceramides and multi-molecular Hyaluronic Acid for 24-hour hydration without pore-clogging heavy oils.
ingredients: Ceramide NP, Hyaluronic Acid (0.5%), Glycerin, Centella Asiatica Extract.
usage: Gently press 1-2 pumps onto damp skin every AM and PM after applying active serums.
usageSteps: Cleanse your face and leave the skin slightly damp.
Apply any active serum first and let it settle for a minute.
Press 1-2 pumps of the gel cream onto your face and neck.
Smooth in with gentle upward strokes until absorbed.
Use every morning and night, adding sunscreen in the daytime.
usageTips: Damp skin helps the hyaluronic acid hold on to water. Layer it over serums, never under them.
usageWarn: Patch test on your inner arm 24 hours before first use. Stop use if redness or stinging continues.

name: 15% Vitamin C Glow Concentrate
description: Potent 15% pure L-Ascorbic Acid stabilized with Ferulic Acid to visibly fade discoloration and defend skin against urban environmental oxidative stress.
ingredients: L-Ascorbic Acid 15%, Ferulic Acid 0.5%, Vitamin E, Hyaluronic Acid.
usage: Apply 3-4 drops in the morning on cleansed skin prior to moisturizer and sunscreen.
usageSteps: Cleanse and pat skin dry.
Place 3-4 drops on your fingertips.
Press, do not rub, over the face and neck, avoiding the eye area.
Wait a minute, then apply moisturizer.
Finish with sunscreen every morning.
usageTips: Vitamin C works best with SPF in the daytime. Store it somewhere cool and dark, and stop using it if it turns dark orange or brown.
usageWarn: A slight tingle is normal when you start. If it burns or stays red, use it every other day or stop. Patch test first.

name: Gentle Melt Cleansing Balm
description: Nourishing oil balm cleanser that effortlessly dissolves long-wear sunscreen and waterproof makeup while supporting natural skin lipid barriers.
ingredients: Sunflower Seed Oil, Oat Kernel Extract, Squalane, Vitamin E.
usage: Massage onto dry skin to melt makeup, emulsify with warm water, and rinse thoroughly.
usageSteps: Start with dry hands and a dry face.
Warm a small amount between your palms.
Massage over your face for 60 seconds to melt sunscreen and makeup.
Wet your hands and keep massaging until the balm turns milky.
Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water and pat dry.
usageTips: Use it on dry skin first. Water at the start stops the oils from lifting makeup.
usageWarn: Close your eyes while massaging near the eye area. Rinse with water if it gets in.

name: Calming BHA Clarifying Solution
description: 2% Salicylic Acid liquid exfoliant that gently unclogs congested pores, smooths rough texture, and minimizes surface sebum shine.
ingredients: Salicylic Acid 2%, Green Tea Extract, Allantoin, Niacinamide.
usage: Saturate a cotton pad and sweep across face 2-3 times per week at night.
usageSteps: Cleanse and pat skin completely dry.
Saturate a cotton pad with the solution.
Sweep across the face, focusing on the nose, chin and forehead. Avoid the eyes and lips.
Leave on, do not rinse.
Follow with moisturizer.
usageTips: Start with 2 nights a week and build up only if your skin stays comfortable.
usageWarn: Wear sunscreen the next morning. Do not use with other strong exfoliants on the same night.
